sections.label: Budget 2018 foundation for future
sections.summary: The Minister for Finance said Budget 2018 lays the foundation for the nation's future amid economic, technological and population changes.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The Minister for Finance said in his Budget Statement that Budget 2018 was about laying the foundation for our nation’s future.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Budget 2018 outlines the steps we will take to prepare for a changing global economic landscape, rapid technological advances and an ageing population.

sections.label: Members on domestic issues
sections.summary: Members welcomed housing, transport and environment measures and discussed education, social services and healthcare, with a joint SG Cares address.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: On domestic issues relating to housing, transport and the environment, Members welcomed the measures to better support families by reducing the waiting time for flats for young couples, to better regulate Personal Mobility Devices (PMDs) and shared-bikes and to make Singapore more environmentally sustainable.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Members also discussed at length enhancements to education, social services delivery and healthcare.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This year, a joint address was delivered by the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF), Ministry of Health (MOH) and MCCY on SG Cares, which reminded us that, in good times and bad, it is the spirit of caring, giving and compassion that binds us together.

sections.label: Reaching the ideal state
sections.summary: The speaker says the ideal state is reached by teaching children to fish, supporting enterprise and lifelong learning, not by promising equal outcomes.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: How do we get to our ideal state?

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: I know that we achieve this not by spoiling our children and giving them everything on a silver platter; not by disregarding how race and religion continue to define us, even though meritocracy means we have equal opportunity; and not by promising our children equal outcomes regardless of effort.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: I know that the best way is to teach our children how to fish instead of promising an endless supply of fish.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: By supporting enterprise, creating a business-friendly environment, providing incentives for lifelong learning and helping workers upskill, enhancing support for education and social services, and fostering an environment of compassion and care, we are providing opportunities for Singaporeans to achieve their dreams, and creating a society where everyone takes ownership.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Every Budget is a social vision and a statement of values.

sections.label: Cuts and hours allocated
sections.summary: As the Leader mentioned, 530 cuts and 51 hours 50 minutes were allocated, the second highest and highest in the recent five years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: As Leader mentioned, 530 cuts, 51 hours and 50 minutes allocated, these are the second highest and highest respectively in the recent five years.

sections.label: BBC interview on long-term planning
sections.summary: A BBC commentator noted Singapore plans a tax increase four years ahead, unlike UK and US governments worried about the next election.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: I recently listened to a British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) interview where a commentator was amazed that a government was able to plan for a tax increase in four years' time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: He noted that we were able to take "medium- to long-term decisions in a way which governments in the United Kingdom (UK) and America are not able to do because they are always worried about the next election." While we should always be circumspect about comments and observations, these comments are worth pondering over.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: I believe that we are only able to think long term when, in our society, there is a sense of "we" and not just "me", and where there is a belief in tomorrow and not just a focus on today.

sections.label: Caring society and fiscal future
sections.summary: The passage states the aim to foster a caring and cohesive society and to ensure a fiscally sustainable and secure future.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: We want to foster a caring and cohesive society.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: And we have to ensure a fiscally sustainable and secure future.

sections.label: Hospice volunteers and living today
sections.summary: A person described his situation as a blessing in some ways, and hospice volunteers learn to live their lives today differently.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: And he might have been quite different if circumstances turned out differently.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: He said, "In some ways, it’s a blessing." When I speak to volunteers at the hospices caring for those who do not have long to live, I realise that many of them learn to live their lives today differently.

sections.label: SG Cares nurturing caring environment
sections.summary: SG Cares is about nurturing an environment where people reach out and care for others.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: SG Cares is about how we nurture an environment where we reach out and care for others.

sections.label: Caring builds bonds among Singaporeans
sections.summary: When Singaporeans care for others, bonds are built that let them go the extra mile for one another.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: When we, as Singaporeans, take the step forward to care for others, when SG Cares, we begin to build bonds that bind, and these bonds enable us to go the extra mile for one another.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Because there is something larger than us that we are fighting for.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: These are the same qualities that will allow us to say the first line of our pledge with conviction, "We, the citizens of Singapore".
